speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcript: This is OPB. I'm Donald Orr. And I'm Tiffany Camhigh. Unless something drastic happens, government funding is set to expire this weekend. The shutdown will mean paychecks to all federal employees, including the military. We'll cease to go out. And some employees will be required to work without pay. Food assistance payments and funding for food and water inspections will also stop. The Senate passed a stopgap funding plan yesterday, but it appears unlikely that it will succeed in the House, where a small group of far-right Republicans are pledging to shut down the government. Here to give us some more context is Congresswoman Lori Chavez-Deremer. She's a Republican who represents Oregon's fifth district, which stretches from Bend to Oregon City. Congresswoman, thanks for joining us.
